purpose: Test one pre-specified market-preserving residual architecture against DIRECT_MARKET without rebuilding absolute market probability or selecting variants by ROI.

data_scope.primary_note: Use the historical EARLY snapshot as actually observed (mostly effective 11 minutes before post); do not relabel it exact 10m.
data_scope.sensitivity_note: Use historical LATE as actually observed (mostly 6 minutes before post); do not relabel it exact 5m.

must_be_frozen_before_lock.newcomer_race_identification_source_and_: TO_BE_FIXED; must be prediction-independent and available without using target race outcome

population.primary: All non-newcomer PRIMARY/EARLY race-card horses with valid positive purchasable pre-race win odds in the preregistered universe; do not retrospectively define population by final abnormal status.
population.zero_prior_starter: keep in probability population with raw residual=0 and no fabricated last-start context

A_DIRECT_MARKET.spec: race-normalized inverse primary EARLY purchasable pre-race win odds

C_CONDITIONAL_RESIDUAL.spec: fixed six-feature conditional market-offset residual learner from candidate draft V6

training.feature_standardization: train history-eligible rows only; mean/population std; frozen transform
training.optimizer: deterministic L-BFGS-B; beta0=zeros; maxiter=2000; gtol=1e-8; ftol=1e-12; maxls=50; maxcor=10

primary_metric: paired race winner log-loss improvement A minus C on primary EARLY
candidate_gate: paired race bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
C binary log loss <= A binary log loss
C improvement > 0 in every preregistered eval month
stopping_fail_closed: Gate v5 real forward provenance not PASS
prohibitions: no LATE rescue or model refit
no final/closing odds as prediction-time market
no real-money betting claim from DEV
